summary: Split declaration KDL parsing so mission no longer names graph: the shared argument and validation helpers move to declaration_syntax and gate parsing to gate_parse; the module layer check now skips string literals and nested comments when it drops test code; the module allowlist shrinks from 6 to 5 pairs

replay.detail: Parsing functions move between modules with the same bodies. Intents and missions parse to the same values, with the same errors.

schema.detail: No database schema, schema version or migration changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and fleet coordination are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No client, protocol, route, CLI output or exit code changes; graph::parse_duration stays at its path through a re-export.

downtime.detail: Nothing to restart beyond a normal upgrade.
